sections.title: Name and growth
sections.text: The plate is labelled Sansevieria kirkii, a name Kew treats as a synonym of Dracaena pethera. This rhizomatous perennial from tropical Africa forms a basal rosette of broad, thick, wavy-edged leaves.

sections.title: Leaves and flowers
sections.text: The pictured leaves have mottled dark markings and reddish margins; the plant also bears a tall flower stalk with pale tubular flowers and round berries. The illustration is consistent with the species description under its accepted name.

sections.title: Uses and caution
sections.text: The sources consulted document its identity and morphology but do not establish a food use or a human edibility profile.
